title: SHUCKED – Great Southern Bank Broadway Season
seo_title: SHUCKED Broadway Musical in Springfield, MO, Jan 2027
description: SHUCKED is a Broadway musical about Maizy and Beau, whose wedding plans collide with the dying corn that protects their small community of Cob County, and the search for answers beyond its borders. It is recommended for ages 10+ and contains adult themes, adult language and corny innuendo. It runs from January 19 to 21, 2027, starting at 7:30 PM, at Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave., Springfield, MO; tickets are currently available only through Broadway Season subscriptions.
